title: 6. Passive Voice र Academic तटस्थता
group: मोड्युल २ · Band 7.0+ Complex Structures र Range Booster
blocks: तपाईंलाई चाहिने हरेक tense-मा passive, passive कहिले रोज्ने, academic तटस्थताका लागि impersonal “It is …” ढाँचाहरू, र दुई वटा मुख्य trap: गलत participle र धेरै प्रयोग।

Passive voice ले कामको object-लाई sentence-को subject बनाइदिन्छ, त्यसैले ध्यान “कसले गर्‍यो” मा होइन, “के भयो” मा पर्छ। Academic writing-लाई formal र impersonal tone दिने दुई-तीन वटा structure मध्ये यो एउटा हो, र IELTS-का २ वटा खास ठाउँमा यो अनिवार्य छ: Task 1 process diagram, जुन लगभग पूरै passive-मा लेखिन्छ, र Task 2 essay, जहाँ व्यक्तिगत register भन्दा impersonal register बढी objective सुनिन्छ। राम्रोसँग प्रयोग गर्दा passive ले तपाईंको tone माथि उठाउँछ; जताततै प्रयोग गर्दा लेखाइ भारी र जिम्मेवारी पन्छाउने जस्तो लाग्छ।

एउटै घटनाको वर्णन गर्ने दुई वटा sentence तुलना गर्नुहोस्: Active: Workers transport the materials. (subject = workers, काम गर्ने) / Passive: The materials are transported (by workers). (subject = materials, जसमाथि काम हुन्छ)

Active voice-मा subject आफैँ काम गर्छ। Passive voice-मा subject-माथि काम हुन्छ, र काम गर्ने (doer) या त हराउँछ, या अन्त्यमा by लगाएर थपिन्छ। Formula कहिल्यै बदलिँदैन: active sentence-को object + be-को एउटा form + past participle (+ by + doer)। be-को सही form (जसले tense बोक्छ) र past participle ठीक भयो भने passive ठीक हुन्छ।
Tense be भागमा हुन्छ; past participle उस्तै रहन्छ। यो table-ले तपाईंलाई साँच्चै चाहिने tense-हरूको रूपान्तर देखाउँछ।
Pattern ध्यान दिनुहोस्: tense जुनसुकै होस्, अन्त्यमा सधैँ past participle (transported) आउँछ, र त्यसको अगाडिको be form बदलिएर समय देखाउँछ।
Passive खास परिस्थितिका लागि एउटा औजार हो, सधैँको बानी होइन। यसलाई यस्तो बेला प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्:
Doer थाहा छैन, प्रस्ट छ, वा महत्त्वपूर्ण छैन। New traffic laws were introduced in 2019. (कसले ल्यायो भन्ने प्रस्टै छ)।
तपाईं objective, impersonal tone चाहनुहुन्छ। It is widely believed that education reduces poverty. (“Many people believe …” भन्दा बढी academic)
तपाईं कुनै process वर्णन गर्दै हुनुहुन्छ। First, the raw beans are harvested. They are then dried, roasted, and ground before the coffee is packaged.
Passive-को एउटा खास र धेरै काम लाग्ने प्रयोग भनेको सामान्य दाबीबाट “I” र “people” हटाउनु हो, जसले लेखाइलाई बढी objective सुनाउँछ। यी ढाँचाहरू सिक्नुहोस्:
People say that tourism harms the coast.
It is said that tourism harms the coast.
Past participle ठीक राख्नुहोस्, र धेरै प्रयोग नगर्नुहोस्

Passive-मा verb-को तेस्रो form चाहिन्छ, base form वा past simple होइन। बंगलादेशी विद्यार्थीहरू प्रायः participle-को अन्त्य छुटाउँछन्। Irregular past participle कण्ठ गर्नै पर्छ (Appendix A हेर्नुहोस्): build/built, write/written, take/taken, give/given, show/shown। साथै, passive धेरै प्रयोग नगर्नुहोस्: पूरै essay passive-मा लेख्दा कडा र अस्वाभाविक सुनिन्छ, र जिम्मेवार को हो भन्ने कुरा लुकाउन सक्छ। Task 2-मा passive र active मिसाएर लेख्नुहोस्।

Trap १ · Past participle छैन वा गलत छ।
✗ The materials are transport to the site. / The bridge was build in 1990. / The report was wrote by the committee.
✓ The materials are transported to the site. / The bridge was built in 1990. / The report was written by the committee.

Trap २ · Passive-को धेरै प्रयोग। Passive-को ठाउँ मुख्यतः Task 1 process र impersonal सामान्य दाबीमा हो; तपाईंका argument र विचार प्रायः active-मा बढी प्रस्ट हुन्छन्।
✗ (पूरै essay passive-मा)
✓ (passive र active मिसाएर; argument active-मा)

सबैभन्दा प्रस्ट उदाहरण Writing Task 1 का process diagram हुन्: हरेक चरणको doer अप्रासंगिक भएकाले पूरै वर्णन passive present simple-मा चल्छ। Active-मै लेखिएको process उत्तर बालकजस्तो सुनिन्छ; यहाँ passive नै अपेक्षित हुन्छ। Writing Task 2-मा passive अझ छानेर प्रयोग हुन्छ, सामान्य भनाइको impersonal tone-का लागि। आफ्नै argument-का लागि active-सँग मिसाएर प्रयोग गर्दा examiner-ले तपाईं register नियन्त्रण गर्न सक्नुहुन्छ भन्ने देख्छन्।

काम लाग्ने skill: Writing, Speaking
Task 1 process: Once the cocoa pods have been harvested, the beans are removed, fermented, and left to dry in the sun.
Task 2 impersonal: It is often argued that stricter regulation is needed, although the costs are frequently underestimated.
Speaking Part 3: A lot is being done to improve recycling, but more could be achieved with better public awareness.
अध्याय ६ सकियो। अब अध्याय ७ (Conditionals, Hedging & Hypothetical Reasoning) आउँछ।

title: 6. Practice · Passive Voice र Academic तटस्थता
group: मोड्युल २ · Band 7.0+ Complex Structures र Range Booster
blocks: Tense जुनसुकै होस्, passive सधैँ past participle मा टुंगिन्छ -- त्यसको अगाडिको 'be' form मात्र बदलिएर समय देखाउँछ। यो एउटै pattern सिक्नुभयो भने तपाईं जुनसुकै active sentence रूपान्तर गर्न सक्नुहुन्छ।
**किन महत्त्वपूर्ण छ:** Passive हरेक tense-मा आउँछ, र IELTS Task 1 र academic writing यसमा निरन्तर भर पर्छन् -- त्यसैले रूपान्तर आफैँ आउने (automatic) हुनुपर्छ।
Tense **be** भागमा हुन्छ; past participle उस्तै रहन्छ।
Present simple: Workers transport the goods. → The goods are transported.
Present continuous: Workers are transporting the goods. → The goods are being transported.
Past simple: Workers transported the goods. → The goods were transported.
नबदलिने कुरा ध्यान दिनुहोस्: tense जुनसुकै होस्, अन्त्यमा सधैँ past participle (transported) आउँछ, र त्यसको अगाडिको be form मात्र बदलिएर समय देखाउँछ।

blocks.title: Exercise 6.1 · Active बाट Passive-मा रूपान्तर
blocks.instructions: हरेक active sentence-लाई उही tense राखेर passive voice-मा फेरि लेख्नुहोस्। Doer प्रस्ट छ भने हटाउनुहोस्, र अर्थ थप्छ भने “by” लगाएर राख्नुहोस्।

items.prompt: Farmers harvest the crop in October.
items.answer: The crop is harvested in October.
accepted: The crop is harvested in October.
The crop is harvested by farmers in October.

items.prompt: The council will build a new bridge next year.
items.answer: A new bridge will be built next year.
accepted: A new bridge will be built next year.

items.answer: The report was written by the committee.
accepted: The report was written by the committee.

items.prompt: Workers are repairing the road at the moment.
items.answer: The road is being repaired at the moment.
accepted: The road is being repaired at the moment.

items.prompt: People have wasted a great deal of water.
items.answer: A great deal of water has been wasted.
accepted: A great deal of water has been wasted.

items.prompt: The government introduced new laws in 2019.
Someone must clean the equipment after every use.
items.answer: The equipment must be cleaned after every use.
accepted: The equipment must be cleaned after every use.
The raw materials are processed by machines.

items.prompt: They had completed the survey before the deadline.
items.answer: The survey had been completed before the deadline.
accepted: The survey had been completed before the deadline.

items.prompt: Volunteers are planting thousands of trees this year.
items.answer: Thousands of trees are being planted this year.
accepted: Thousands of trees are being planted this year.

items.prompt: The factory produces two thousand cars a day.
items.answer: Two thousand cars are produced a day.
accepted: Two thousand cars are produced a day.

items.prompt: A famous architect designed the building.
items.answer: The building was designed by a famous architect.
accepted: The building was designed by a famous architect.
items.reason: “by” phrase-ले साँच्चैको जानकारी थपिरहेको छ, त्यसैले यसलाई राख्नुहोस्।

accepted: Recycling should be encouraged by the authorities.

items.prompt: Engineers are testing the new system.
items.answer: The new system is being tested.
accepted: The new system is being tested.

items.prompt: People believe that tourism damages the environment. (use the impersonal “It is …”)
items.answer: It is believed that tourism damages the environment.
accepted: It is believed that tourism damages the environment.

blocks: Passive सधैँको बानी होइन -- यो ३ वटा खास परिस्थितिका लागि औजार हो: doer थाहा नभएको वा प्रस्ट भएको बेला, objective tone चाहिँदा, र कुनै process वर्णन गर्दा। Process diagram ठ्याक्कै यही तेस्रो अवस्था हो।
**किन महत्त्वपूर्ण छ:** Process-diagram भएको Task 1 passive बिना स्वाभाविक रूपमा लेख्नै लगभग असम्भव छ, किनकि चरणहरू कसले गर्छ भन्दा चरणहरू नै बढी महत्त्वपूर्ण हुन्छन्।
**Doer थाहा छैन, प्रस्ट छ, वा महत्त्वपूर्ण छैन**: New traffic laws were introduced in 2019 (कसले ल्यायो भन्ने प्रस्टै छ)।
तपाईं **objective, impersonal tone** चाहनुहुन्छ: It is widely believed that education reduces poverty ("many people believe" भन्दा बढी academic)।
तपाईं **कुनै process वर्णन गर्दै हुनुहुन्छ** -- चरणहरूको एउटा क्रम, जहाँ ध्यान विभिन्न चरण पार गर्दै जाने सामग्री वा उत्पादनमा हुन्छ, काम गर्ने मानिसहरूमा होइन।
खासगरी process diagram-मा हरेक चरण passive-मा र एउटै tense-मा (प्रायः present simple) राख्नुहोस्, ताकि क्रम कामदारहरूको कथा जस्तो नभई एउटा system जस्तो पढियोस्।

blocks.title: Exercise 6.2 · Process Diagram लेखाइ
blocks.instructions: सुरुदेखि अन्त्यसम्म passive present simple र उपयुक्त sequencing word (first, then, next, after that, once, finally) प्रयोग गरेर करिब १५० शब्दको एउटा paragraph लेख्नुहोस्।

items.prompt: Write one paragraph of about 150 words describing how glass bottles are recycled, using the passive present simple throughout and sequencing words. Stages: used glass bottles collected from homes and bins; transported to a recycling plant; sorted by colour; washed to remove labels and dirt; crushed into small pieces called cullet; melted in a furnace at very high temperature; moulded into new bottles; new bottles filled, labelled, and sent to shops.
items.answer: The diagram illustrates the process by which used glass bottles are recycled into new ones. First, used bottles are collected from homes and public bins, after which they are transported to a recycling plant. On arrival, the glass is sorted by colour into clear, green, and brown, and it is then washed thoroughly so that labels and dirt are removed. Next, the clean glass is crushed into small fragments known as cullet. Once this stage is complete, the cullet is melted in a furnace at an extremely high temperature until it becomes liquid. The molten glass is then moulded into the shape of new bottles. Finally, the finished bottles are filled, labelled, and sent to shops, where the cycle can begin again.
accepted: The diagram illustrates the process by which used glass bottles are recycled into new ones. First, used bottles are collected from homes and public bins, after which they are transported to a recycling plant. On arrival, the glass is sorted by colour into clear, green, and brown, and it is then washed thoroughly so that labels and dirt are removed. Next, the clean glass is crushed into small fragments known as cullet. Once this stage is complete, the cullet is melted in a furnace at an extremely high temperature until it becomes liquid. The molten glass is then moulded into the shape of new bottles. Finally, the finished bottles are filled, labelled, and sent to shops, where the cycle can begin again.
items.reason: हरेक चरण passive present simple-मा छ (are collected, is sorted, is melted, are sent), किनकि doer अप्रासंगिक छ; क्रम देखाउने शब्दहरूले (first, then, next, once, finally) क्रमलाई जोडेर राखेका छन्; र tense सुरुदेखि अन्त्यसम्म एउटै रहेको छ।
